notes: Curated heritage sites shown by the heritage layer. OpenStreetMap maps hundreds of historic features in the region (historic=*) but rarely their listing, so World Heritage Sites, heritage precincts and protected monuments are listed here with the OpenStreetMap feature that represents each (place id = osm_id x 10 + type). status: unesco (UNESCO World Heritage Site, with the year of inscription), precinct (heritage precinct) or monument (listed heritage structure or protected monument). Add a site with a source for its status.

sites.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
sites.description: Victorian Gothic railway terminus by F. W. Stevens, completed in 1888; formerly Victoria Terminus.

sites.name: Elephanta Caves
sites.description: Rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Shiva on Elephanta Island in Mumbai Harbour.

sites.name: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai
sites.description: The Victorian Gothic public buildings and the Art Deco apartments facing each other across the Oval Maidan, with Marine Drive's Art Deco seafront.
sites.wikipedia: en:Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai

sites.name: Fort Precinct
sites.description: The old walled city of Bombay around Horniman Circle: banks, offices and institutions of the 19th and early 20th century.

sites.name: Kala Ghoda
sites.description: Art district of museums, galleries and heritage buildings south of Fort.

sites.name: Ballard Estate
sites.description: Business district laid out on reclaimed land in the early 20th century, with uniform Edwardian neo-classical buildings.

sites.name: Marine Drive
sites.description: The seafront promenade along Back Bay, lined with Art Deco buildings.

sites.name: Banganga Tank
sites.description: Ancient water tank surrounded by temples in Walkeshwar, Malabar Hill.

sites.name: Dadar Parsi Colony
sites.description: Planned residential enclave of the 1920s, with Art Deco villas around gardens and an agiary.

sites.name: Gateway of India
sites.description: Indo-Saracenic arch on the Apollo Bunder waterfront, completed in 1924.

sites.name: Kanheri Caves
sites.description: Buddhist cave complex in Sanjay Gandhi National Park, carved from the 1st century BCE.

sites.name: Bandra Fort
sites.description: Portuguese watchtower fort (Castella de Aguada) of 1640 at Land's End, Bandra.

sites.name: Worli Fort
sites.description: British fort of around 1675 overlooking Mahim Bay.

sites.name: Sewri Fort
sites.description: British fort of 1680 on a hillock above the Sewri mudflats.

sites.name: Mahim Fort
sites.description: Fort on Mahim Bay, facing Bandra Fort across the creek.
